rationale: With 55 minutes remaining in the session and the broader market worsening (SPY down -1.52%, VIXY up +8.50%), SPOT has lost short-term upward momentum, slipping below its 5-minute 9-EMA ($580.62) after retracing more than half of its maximum favorable excursion (down from 1.22% to 0.55%).
